notes: Ordered rules; the first match wins. Purpose says why a route exists.
Status says why it is or is not imported, and is overridden to BOUND for any
route the ctypes manifest actually imports.
ACTIONABLE_LOCAL means: needed by a selected deliverable and implementable now.
A capability CNA offers that this product has not selected is a deliberate
non-binding, not an outstanding task; binding a route with no consumer is not

rules.reason: Frame generation is what XNA's two alternating frame textures need for change detection; selected for the VideoPlayer.GetTexture projection.
RenderTarget2D/Cube ContentLost is XNA public surface and CNA now has the subscription; delivery only happens on renderers that can lose a device.
XNA's GraphicsDevice constructor and Dispose are public; CNA now has an owned device rather than only the Game's borrowed one.
CNA documents that no native object pointer crosses the ABI for these events, so XNA's ResourceCreatedEventArgs.Resource cannot be supplied and would have to be fabricated.
